title: board ship commits the card, column Ship, onto the work branch
notes: Every shipped card's branch starts with a 'board: ship' commit (e.g. c6d62239 on pane-send-refuses-text-that-starts-claude) that sets the card's column to Ship in .dashboard/board/cards/<id>.json. The PR carries that file; when it merges, main's card is written back to Ship, which can start an agent on a card already done (#310 hit this). Seen on #317 and #318 the same day. The ship should write the card on origin's default branch only, never into the worktree's branch, and a test should hold it. Found 2026-11-17.
